title: Each Moon Rocket Engine Burned 5,683 Pounds Every Second

scenes.text: Each Moon rocket engine burned 5,683 pounds every second.
The Saturn V's first stage had five of them, called F-1 engines.
Together they burned about 28,000 pounds of fuel and oxygen a second.
For roughly two and a half minutes, that added up to more than four million pounds.
Each engine produced 1.5 million pounds of thrust.
Then they were thrown away, and the rocket was just getting started.

description:
Each Moon rocket engine burned 5,683 pounds every second.
The F-1 engine on the Saturn V burned about 5,683 pounds of kerosene and liquid oxygen per second. Five of them, for about two and a half minutes, produced 1.5 million pounds of thrust each.
Would you have watched that launch? Comment below.
first_comment: Four million pounds of fuel in under three minutes. What's the biggest machine you've ever seen?
